components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a strip; ink fill, never amber.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.875rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; background: var(--ink, #ede6da); color: var(--ground, #16161a); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #ede6da); border-radius: 2px; font: 600 0.875rem/1 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a39e94; border-color: #a39e94; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0a84f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action with a strong hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.875rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; background: transparent; color: #ede6da; border: 1px solid #4d4d55; border-radius: 2px; font: 600 0.875rem/1 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #1e1e23; border-color: #a39e94; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0a84f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Muted header link that goes to ink when hovered or current.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; color: #a39e94; font: 520 0.875rem 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current='true'] { color: #ede6da; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0a84f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Stage Block
components.description: A pipeline diagram block; selection is a filled marker and doubled amber border.
components.css: .ds-stage { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.15em; padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem; min-width: 11rem; background: #1e1e23; color: #ede6da; border: 1px solid #4d4d55; border-radius: 2px; font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-stage:hover { background: #25252b; border-color: #a39e94; } .ds-stage[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: #e0a84f; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #e0a84f; } .ds-stage__label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45em; font-weight: 620; } .ds-stage__label::before { content: ''; width: 0.5em; height: 0.5em; border: 1.5px solid #a39e94; } .ds-stage[aria-pressed='true'] .ds-stage__label::before { border-color: #e0a84f; background: #e0a84f; } .ds-stage__sub { padding-left: 0.95em; color: #a39e94; font-size: 0.86em; font-stretch: 78%; }

components.name: Ruled Spec Table
components.description: Parameter tables with hairline rows and tabular numerals.
components.css: .ds-table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font: 0.875rem/1.5 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; color: #ede6da; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 0.75rem 1rem 0.75rem 0; border-top: 1px solid #33333a; text-align: left; } .ds-table thead th { color: #a39e94; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; font-stretch: 78%; border-top: 1px solid #4d4d55; border-bottom: 1px solid #4d4d55; } .ds-table tbody th { font-weight: 600; } .ds-table .n { text-align: right; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: The site reads like the datasheet for a part: a general description, a block diagram, characteristic tables, test conditions, operating limits. The engineer is presented the way a careful manufacturer presents a component, by what it does, how it is wired, how it was tested and where it stops working. Credibility comes from specificity and stated limits, not adjectives. Surfaces are a dark charcoal sheet with warm white ink; the light theme is the same sheet printed on paper. Structure is carried by 1px hairline rules, ruled tables with tabular numerals, and block-diagram linework, never by cards or shadows. There is vast quiet ground around each section's single figure. One sodium amber marks live signal and focus, nothing else.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline-ruled tables and key/value rows instead of cards.
One explorable block diagram as the signature figure.
Archivo's width axis does the hierarchy: expanded display, condensed table heads.
State is drawn by stroke pattern plus text, never colour alone.
Amber is rare: signal path, selection, focus.

rules.name: The Signal-Only Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber marks where the signal is or where focus is. Primary actions are filled with ink, not amber.

rules.name: The Stroke-Not-Colour Rule
rules.body: Solid means always runs or done; dashed means depends on input or still open; dotted frames the per-claim loop. Every such mark also carries a text label.

rules.name: The Literal Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for file names, function names and status codes only. Connecting words stay in Archivo. Paths may break only after "/".

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No label above a heading. Headings stand alone; sentence case throughout.

dos: Do put every claim beside its evidence: a file, a test, or a figure.
Do keep amber to the signal path, selection and focus.
Do draw state with stroke pattern and label it in text.
Do use ruled tables for anything that has parameters and values.
Do gate entrance motion behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; with reduced motion, animations are removed, not shortened.
donts: Don't fill buttons or large areas with amber.
Don't use cards, card grids, or big-number stat rows.
Don't put a label or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't add neon, gradients, glass, blobs, stock imagery, fake terminals, emoji or skill scores.
